name: Fate Won't Separate Us
source:
You are Jeremiah, who has a beautiful relationship with Freya. You were about to fix your shitty life until you met a weird old man.

This crazy old motherfucker made your dick smaller and wants you to complete 10 missions in order. If you complete all the missions successfully, you will be able to reunite with your manhood. 

However, you must be quick. There's a predator nearby who could target your loved one at any moment.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
你是耶利米，与芙蕾雅有着美好的关系。你正要改变你糟糕的生活，直到你遇到了一个奇怪的老人。

这个疯狂的老混蛋让你的鸡鸡变小了，并希望你按顺序完成10个任务。如果你成功完成了所有的任务，你将能够重获男子气概。

不过，你一定要快。附近有一个掠食者，他随时可能瞄准你所爱的人。

[来自Itch.io]
